title: 第0025章 上品功法被盯上了第0026章 吕云川猎妖邀请
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
;;
美艳侍女很快的给出价格。
“【火蛇术】，售价200灵石。”
“【木藤缠绕】，售价180灵石。”
“【石灵镇岳】，售价180灵石。”
“【中级云雨术】，售价240灵石。”
“【庚金剑气】，售价280灵石。”
“道友需要支付1280灵石。”
陆青禾有些愕然，他没有想到中品术法价格竟然如此之高，初级术法不超过十枚灵石。
当然中级术法竟然最低都是180灵石，价格超过十倍以上。
陆青禾说道：“价格太高了，能不能优惠？”
他虽然有三千八百多灵石，可是购买术法就需要这么多灵石，他也很是心疼。
美艳侍女说道：“道友，这是最优惠的价格了，我相信整个青云仙坊聚宝阁售卖的术法是最实惠的，而且是质量最好的。”
这话陆青禾是不相信的，谁卖东西不都是这样说。
看陆青禾不说话，美艳侍女开口道：“如果道友诚心买，过千的买卖，我可以个人做主优惠道友十灵石。”
能优惠十灵石就十灵石，不要小看十灵石，在太玄宗，一个杂役弟子至少数年的努力才能够攒够十灵石。
陆青禾又问道：“这里有没有能够掩藏修为的功法，最好是能够瞒过筑基真人。”
炼气初期，炼气中期不使用实力很难看出他人的修为。
但是到了炼气后期，灵识蜕变为神识，就可以查探他人的修为了。
之前将实力提升到炼气四层就让白羽彤和外门长老注意到了，幸好搪塞了过去，而且两人不知道他是五灵根，认为他是四灵根。

以后要是被人知道他一个五灵根突破如此快，必定会被让人惦记。
美艳侍女虽然好奇陆青禾会想要购买这样的功法。
她想了一下：“这样的功法太少了，更何况能够瞒过筑基真人的掩藏修为功法，不过在聚宝阁倒是收录了一份。
只是这是一卷上品功法，价格颇高，售价2000灵石，但是只要修炼大成，筑基真人要不是神识过人，也很难察觉道友的修为。”
两千灵石，哪怕是财大气粗的陆青禾也被吓到了。
“道友你们聚宝阁这是在抢劫啊。”
陆青禾觉得抢劫来灵石都没有这样快，但是这种功法他是势在必得。
美艳女修回道：“道友，这可是上品功法，上品功法原本就价格昂贵，这样的功法在整个青云仙坊也只有我们聚宝阁会有。
其他的功法店铺，能够拿得出来中品功法就算不错了。”
这点陆青禾相信，上品术法不说青云仙坊，哪怕在太玄宗也是珍贵无比，寻常弟子根本接触不到。
陆青禾斟酌了一下：“我只能够支付1800灵石，道友愿意我就买了，包括五门中品术法。”
美艳女修摇摇头：“这样聚宝阁就亏本了，1950灵石，我让道友50灵石。”
“1900灵石！”
“成交，道友需要支付2180灵石。”
“先将术法给我看看是否真假。”
美艳女修立刻将六个玉简交给陆青禾，大部分被封印，防止别人窃取。

The beautiful maid quickly gave the price.
"[Fire Snake Technique], priced at 200 spirit stones."
"[Wood and Vine Wrapping], priced at 180 spirit stones."
"[Shi Ling Zhen Yue], priced at 180 spirit stones."
"[Intermediate Cloud and Rain Technique], priced at 240 spirit stones."
"[Gengjin Sword Qi], priced at 280 spirit stones."
"Fellow Taoist needs to pay 1,280 spirit stones."
Lu Qinghe was a little stunned. He did not expect that the price of mid-level spells was so high, and the price of elementary spells did not exceed ten spirit stones.
Of course, the minimum price for intermediate spells is 180 spirit stones, which is more than ten times the price.
Lu Qinghe said: "The price is too high, can we get a discount?"
Although he had more than 3,800 spiritual stones, he needed so many spiritual stones to purchase spells, and he felt very distressed.
The beautiful maid said: "Fellow Taoist, this is the best price. I believe that the spells sold in the entire Qingyun Immortal Palace Jubao Pavilion are the most affordable and of the best quality."
Lu Qinghe didn't believe this. Not everyone who sells things said this.
Seeing that Lu Qinghe didn't speak, the beautiful maid said: "If you, the Taoist, are sincere in buying it, and the transaction is over a thousand, I can personally make the decision and give you ten spiritual stones."
If you can get ten spirit stones at a discount, then ten spirit stones are enough. Don't underestimate ten spirit stones. In Taixuan Sect, a handyman disciple can save ten spirit stones with at least several years of hard work.
Lu Qinghe asked again: "Is there any technique here that can hide one's cultivation? It would be best to hide it from Master Ji Zhu."
In the early and middle stages of Qi refining, it is difficult to see other people's cultivation without using their strength.
But in the later stage of Qi refining, spiritual consciousness transforms into divine consciousness, and you can check the cultivation level of others.
Bai Yutong and the outer sect elders noticed that he had upgraded his strength to the fourth level of Qi Refining before. Fortunately, they were able to prevaricate him. Moreover, they did not know that he had five spiritual roots and thought he had four spiritual roots.
In the future, if anyone knew that he had broken through the Five Spiritual Roots so quickly, he would definitely be remembered.
Although the beautiful maid was curious that Lu Qinghe would want to buy such a technique.
She thought for a moment: "There are too few such techniques, not to mention the hidden cultivation techniques that can hide from Master Zhuji, but there is a copy in the Jubao Pavilion.
It's just that this is a volume of high-grade skills, and the price is quite high, selling for 2,000 spirit stones. However, as long as the cultivation is completed, it will be difficult for Master Ji Zhu to detect the cultivation level of his fellow Taoists unless he has extraordinary spiritual awareness. "
With two thousand spirit stones, even the wealthy Lu Qinghe was frightened.
"Fellow Taoist, you are robbing Treasure Pavilion."
Lu Qinghe felt that it was not so fast to obtain spiritual stones even if he was robbed, but he was bound to get this kind of technique.
The beautiful female cultivator replied: "Fellow Taoist, this is a top-grade technique. Top-grade techniques are inherently expensive. Only our Jubao Pavilion has such a technique in the entire Qingyun Immortal Square.
Other Kung Fu shops are considered good if they can provide mid-level Kung Fu techniques. "
Lu Qinghe believes that top-grade magic techniques, not to mention Qingyun Immortal Studio, are extremely precious even in Taixuan Sect and are beyond the reach of ordinary disciples.
Lu Qinghe considered it for a moment: "I can only pay 1,800 spirit stones. If my fellow Taoist is willing, I will buy it, including five middle-grade spells."
The beautiful female cultivator shook her head: "In this way, Jubao Pavilion will lose money. It's 1950 spirit stones. I'll give fellow Taoist 50 spirit stones."
"1900 spiritual stones!"
"The deal is done. Fellow Taoist needs to pay 2180 spirit stones."
"Show me the technique first to see if it is real or fake."
The beautiful female cultivator immediately handed the six jade slips to Lu Qinghe, and most of them were sealed to prevent others from stealing them.
